intro: I'm a computer science student at Merrimack College interested in AI, machine learning, and entrepreneurship. I'm exploring how AI-assisted development can turn ideas into useful applications, games, and tools.
Alongside my studies, I work as an IT Help Desk Technician at Merrimack College and a seasonal retail associate at Bath & Body Works. Outside of school and work, I enjoy fitness, anime, and cars.
